mechanics.name: Storied
mechanics.summary: A permanent with storied gives you an enduring story once you control three or more artifacts, legendary permanents, and/or Sagas; that designation lasts for the rest of the game.

mechanics.name: Recruit
mechanics.summary: Draw a card, then discard a card; discarding a nonland card also creates a 1/1 white Human Soldier token, joining card selection to go-wide pressure.

mechanics.name: Hone counters
mechanics.summary: Each hone counter on an Equipment gives the equipped creature +1/+0, letting repeated honing turn modest weapons into serious threats.

mechanics.name: Adventures
mechanics.summary: Cast the Adventure half first and exile the card as it resolves, then cast its permanent half from exile for two spells and flexible curve coverage from one card.

mechanics.name: Amass
mechanics.summary: Put +1/+1 counters on an Army you control, or create a 0/0 black Goblin Army token first if you have none; repeated amass effects build one scalable sacrifice body.

mechanics.name: Landfall
mechanics.summary: Triggers whenever a land you control enters, rewarding extra land drops, land recursion, and holding lands to generate tempo or creature growth on demand.

archetypes.name: Humans recruit and draw-two
archetypes.playstyle: Recruit after the draw step to turn the turn's second card into counters, lifelink, mill, and combat pressure while the discarded nonlands become Human Soldier tokens. Cheap Adventures and efficient interaction keep mana moving as the token board grows.

archetypes.name: Goblins amass-sacrifice
archetypes.playstyle: Build a counter-laden Goblin Army, attack to amass again, and cash in expendable creatures, artifacts, or the Army when removal and impulse-draw outlets make the exchange profitable. Death triggers and menace keep damage flowing through trades.

archetypes.name: Wolves ferocious midrange
archetypes.playstyle: Establish a creature with power 4 or greater, then send the pack to switch on attack-draw, counters, trample, and lifegain. Efficient black removal protects the ferocious engine while green's large bodies and ramp dominate combat.

archetypes.name: Dwarves storied Equipment
archetypes.playstyle: Curve legendary Dwarves, Equipment, and Sagas into an enduring story, then collect ward, stats, attack taxes, and doubled Dwarf triggers. Treasure and Equipment makers reach the three-permanent threshold without sacrificing combat tempo.
payoffs: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills

archetypes.name: Elves landfall-control
archetypes.playstyle: Develop lands and preserve extra land drops to trigger tap-and-untap tempo, creature growth, and Elf production exactly when needed. Land-finding, land recursion, and a compact Elf subtheme build toward Mirkwood Pathmaker while interaction controls the air and ground.

combos.note: Recruit after your draw step supplies the second draw for Bard, a Soldier token when you discard a nonland, and a +1/+1 counter with lifelink
Long Lake Nuisance recruits on entry, turning the turn's second draw into an Apothecary counter while potentially adding a Soldier
Celebrate recruits to trigger Councillors' mill, and both the mill and recruit discard accelerate its seven-card-graveyard bonus
Patient Instructor recruits on entry and a nonland discard creates another creature, immediately increasing Garrison's power
Sacrifice the Pair to Hunter for an impulse card and its death trigger amasses Goblins 4
The Pair pays Stir Up Trouble's sacrifice cost, so one exchange destroys a creature and leaves four +1/+1 counters on your Army
Casting Tidings triggers Noisemaker before the spell amasses again; flashback repeats the trigger and upgrades Tidings to amass 3
Sacrificing Sentries to Bolg adds its death-trigger -1/-1 to Bolg's damage, improving the kill and the chance of excess-damage amass
The hasty 4-power Bear immediately switches on the Chief Warg's attack trigger for a card
The on-curve 4-power Bear enables Pursuer's ferocious attack pump
Pump Prowler before combat to reach 4 power and lock in Rabbit's beginning-of-combat +1/+1 counter
At four lands Pathmaker turns on ferocious, so Scrounger's attack grows the whole team
Thorin and legendary Dori count twice toward storied, and Dori's Treasure is the third permanent that establishes an enduring story

cards: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills
combos.note: Dáin, legendary Dori, and Dori's Treasure reach the storied threshold and switch on Dáin's attack tax
With an enduring story, Bifur doubles the Blacksmith Dwarf's enter trigger to create two Axe Equipment tokens
Shortsword's Equipment entry triggers Kíli's draw and its Dwarf token supplies another body; an enduring story also makes the first equip free
Discarding a land to Reveler's entry puts it onto the battlefield, triggering Thranduil to create an Elf that immediately receives his anthem
Wood Elves puts a Forest onto the battlefield to trigger Thranduil's Elf token, and his anthem boosts both Elves
Nurturer can return a land you control; replay it to trigger Raft-Steerer and tap a blocker or untap a creature
Every landfall gives Wanderers +2/+2 for the turn and Hospitality adds a permanent +1/+1 counter
